Adequate protein intake also supports the immune system per Vahid and Rahmani (2021). They state that the anti-
inflammatory diet not only aids the immune system but also boosts lung function and decreases oxidation. 
Turmeric is a spice hailed for its anti-inflammatory properties. Turmeric contains curcumin (Vahid & Rahmani, 
2021), which inhibits the expression of cytokines, thus decreasing the inflammatory response. This inhibitor has 
also been proposed as an antiviral intermediary for RTI (Vahid & Rahmani, 2021).
